name: ASM · 01 Discovery
description: Stage 1: subfinder (+ optional alterx) for roots, dnsx resolution, mapcidr expansion, scope filter. Writes hosts/ips/cname lists.

parameters.jsCode:
const STAGE = 'discovery';
const MAX_MINUTES = 120;
const BODY = "SC="$R/scope"
drun() { docker run --rm -i --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$S:/w" -w /w "$@"; }

: > names.raw.txt
if [ -s "$SC/domains.txt" ]; then
  timeout 45m subfinder -dL "$SC/domains.txt" -silent -o subfinder.txt >/dev/null 2>subfinder.log || true
  cat "$SC/domains.txt" >> names.raw.txt
  [ -f subfinder.txt ] && cat subfinder.txt >> names.raw.txt
fi
[ -s "$SC/hosts.txt" ] && cat "$SC/hosts.txt" >> names.raw.txt
python3 "$SC/scope.py" names < names.raw.txt > names.txt

if [ "$PERMUTE" = 1 ] && [ -s names.txt ]; then
  drun projectdiscovery/alterx:v0.0.6 -silent -limit 20000 < names.txt > alterx.txt 2>alterx.log || true
  cat names.txt alterx.txt | python3 "$SC/scope.py" names > names.perm.txt
  mv names.perm.txt names.txt
fi

: > dnsx.jsonl
if [ -s names.txt ]; then
  timeout 30m dnsx -l names.txt -silent -a -cname -resp -json -retry 2 -o dnsx.jsonl >/dev/null 2>dnsx.log || true
  touch dnsx.jsonl
fi

: > cidr_ips.txt
if [ -s "$SC/cidrs.txt" ]; then
  cp "$SC/cidrs.txt" cidrs.txt
  drun projectdiscovery/mapcidr:v1.1.16 -cl /w/cidrs.txt -silent > cidr_ips.raw.txt 2>mapcidr.log || true
  python3 "$SC/scope.py" ips < cidr_ips.raw.txt > cidr_ips.txt
fi

CACHE=/opt/loot/asm/_cache
mkdir -p "$CACHE"
AWS="$CACHE/aws-ip-ranges.json"
if [ -z "$(find "$AWS" -mmin -1440 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  curl -s -m 30 -o "$AWS.tmp" https://ip-ranges.amazonaws.com/ip-ranges.json && jq -e '.prefixes' "$AWS.tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 && mv "$AWS.tmp" "$AWS"
  rm -f "$AWS.tmp"
fi
: > service_nets.txt
[ -s "$AWS" ] && jq -r '.prefixes[] | select(.service == "S3" or .service == "API_GATEWAY") | .ip_prefix' "$AWS" | sort -u > service_nets.txt

jq -r '.a[]?' dnsx.jsonl 2>/dev/null | sort -u > resolved_ips.txt
: > edge_ips.txt
if [ -s resolved_ips.txt ]; then
  docker run --rm -i projectdiscovery/cdncheck:v1.1.36 -resp -jsonl -silent -duc < resolved_ips.txt 2>cdncheck.log \
    | jq -r 'select(.cdn == true or .waf == true) | "\(.ip) \(.cdn_name // .waf_name // "edge")"' > edge_ips.txt || true
fi

counts=$(python3 "$SC/scope.py" resolve dnsx.jsonl cidr_ips.txt . service_nets.txt edge_ips.txt)
jq -nc --argjson c "$counts" --argjson names "$(wc -l < names.txt)" '$c + {names: $names}' > result.json
";
const c = $input.first().json;
const SAFE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_./:-]+$/;
const q = (k) => {
  const v = String(c[k] ?? '');
  if (!SAFE.test(v)) throw new Error(`Unsafe or missing context value for ${k}: ${v}`);
  return `'${v}'`;
};
const int = (v, lo, hi, d) => Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(v ?? d, 10) || d, lo), hi);
const header = [
  '#!/usr/bin/env bash',
  'set -uo pipefail',
  `R=${q('run_dir')}`,
  `S=${q('run_dir').slice(0, -1)}/${STAGE}'`,
  `ENG=${q('engagement')}`,
  `RUN_ID=${q('run_id')}`,
  `STATE=${q('state_dir')}`,
  `RATE=${int(c.rate, 1, 500, 50)}`,
  `PORT_RATE=${int(c.port_rate, 50, 2000, 500)}`,
  `INTRUSIVE=${c.intrusive === true ? 1 : 0}`,
  `PERMUTE=${c.permute === true ? 1 : 0}`,
  'mkdir -p "$S" && cd "$S" || exit 1',
  ''
].join('
');
return [{ json: { job_dir: `${c.run_dir}/${STAGE}`, script: header + BODY, max_minutes: MAX_MINUTES } }];
